Become a World Class Content creator

Monetize Your Passion, build a personal brand, turn your voice, ideas, and creativity into a profitable career.

Enrol Now
Apply For Scholarship

Beginner Friendly

No prior experience required.

Job Placement Support

Launch your career with internships and job placements.

Flexible Learning

Choose to learn at a pace that fits your schedule.

World-Class Tutors & Mentorship

Learn directly from industry experts.

Certificate

Earn a recognised certificate.

Download Course Brochure & Curriculum

Course Overview

The Becoming an Influencer (Content Creation) course teaches you how to grow an authentic digital presence, create engaging content, and build a profitable personal or faceless brand.

You’ll learn to master storytelling, video editing, and platform strategy — while discovering how to monetize through collaborations, digital products, and automation.

Whether you want to become a visible creator or build a faceless content brand, this course gives you the skills and strategy to thrive in today’s creator economy.

Learning Outcome

  1. Build and grow an authentic (or faceless) digital brand that connects with your target audience.
  2. Create scroll-stopping videos, photos, and written content optimized for different platforms.
  3. Use analytics, consistency, and storytelling frameworks to grow and engage an online community.
  4. Monetize your influence through partnerships, sponsorships, and personal product launches.
    •

Duration: 2 months
Enrol Now
Apply For Scholarship

Career Opportunities

  1. United States – $45,000 – $100,000 USD
  2. United Kingdom – £30,000 – £70,000 GBP
  3. Canada – $40,000 – $85,000 CAD
  4. Germany – €35,000 – €70,000 EUR
  5. Nigeria – ₦2.5 million – ₦7 million NGN
  6. Kenya – KSh 1.6 million – KSh 3.8 million KES
  7. Remote/Global Roles – $35,000 – $90,000 USD

Career Pathways

  1. DevOps Engineer
  2. Cloud Engineer
  3. Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
  4. Infrastructure Engineer
  5. Automation Engineer

What You Will Learn

Go from Idea to Impact, become a Content Creator in 3-6 Months.

Module 1: Introduction to the Creator Economy
  • Understanding today’s creator ecosystem and digital influence
  • Creator business models: personal brand, faceless brand, niche expert, educator, or entertainer
  • The difference between being a content creator vs influencer vs entrepreneur
  • Finding your niche and purpose as a creator
Module 2 - Building Your Personal Brand
  • Defining your niche and audience
  • Crafting your tone, aesthetic, unique story, values, and voice
  • Designing your visual identity (colors, fonts, tone)
  • Faceless marketing strategies
  • Case studies
Module 3 - Content Strategy & Planning
  • Content planning, scripting, and storytelling
  • Balancing value-driven content: educational, inspirational, entertaining
  • Shooting and editing using your phone or camera
  • Visual design and basic editing tools (CapCut, Canva, VN, Lightroom)
  • Tools for planning and automation: Linktree, Manychat, Notion, Later, Metricool, Zapier
  • Defining KPIs and tracking growth
Module 4 - Platform-Specific Strategies
  • Researching
  • Deep dive into key platforms
  • Choosing the right platform(s) for your goals
Module 5 - Content Creation & Production Skills
  • Shooting professional videos using your phone or camera
  • Lighting, framing, and audio techniques for all budgets
  • Editing for speed and engagement with CapCut, VN, Canva, and Descript
  • Batch creation and time management for consistency
Module 6 - Growing Your Audience
  • Understanding platform algorithms
  • Engagement and community-building strategies
  • Signals: saves, shares, and watch time
  • Collaborations, trends, and cross-platform growth
  • Using analytics dashboards to identify high-performing content
  • Iteration and testing — how to evolve your strategy
Module 7 - Monetization & Brand Partnerships
  • Understanding platform algorithms
  • Engagement and community-building strategies
  • Signals: saves, shares, and watch time
  • Collaborations, trends, and cross-platform growth
  • Using analytics dashboards to identify high-performing content
  • Iteration and testing — how to evolve your strategy
Module 8 - Automation & Scaling
  • Automating your workflow: from posting to reporting
  • Outsourcing editing, scheduling, or scriptwriting
  • Using AI tools (ChatGPT, OpusClip, Synthesia, Descript) for creative automation
  • Building long-term systems for content and revenue growth
Module 9: Capstone Project
  • Create a 30-day content strategy for your brand or faceless niche
  • Build sample posts, video scripts, and engagement plans
  • Present your growth roadmap and personal creator portfolio

I don’t have a tech background.
70% of our graduates started with zero tech experiences. Our beginner-friendly approach starts with basics and builds progressively
I can’t afford it
Up to 50-100% scholarship coverage available. You only pay registration and certification fees upfront.
I don't have time
Flexible learning schedules including evenings and weekends. Complete the program while maintaining your current job.

Guaranteed internship placement + access to exclusive job board with 500+ partner companies actively hiring our graduates
